schema.label: family name
schema.functional_roles: tags such as proton_donor, lewis_acid, dehydrating_agent, noncoordinating_acid, solid_acid, silylating_agent, halophile

effect_bands.bronsted_acidity_band: very weak / weak / medium / strong / very strong
effect_bands.lewis_acidity_band: very low / low / medium / high / very high
effect_bands.counteranion_coordinating_band: very low / low / medium / high / very high (lower is 'more weakly coordinating')
effect_bands.hydrolytic_instability_band: very low / low / medium / high / very high
effect_bands.hygroscopicity_band: very low / low / medium / high / very high
effect_bands.oxidizing_power_band: very low / low / medium / high / very high

schema.typical_solvent_classes: array of solvent-class identifiers (e.g., halogenated, ethers_cyclic_glymes, amides_dipolar_aprotic)
schema.example_members: array of {name, abbr, cas?, counteranion?, synonyms[], numeric_features{}, embedding_text}
schema.ehs_green: EHS/green flags at family or member level
schema.condition_links: array of {reaction_family, core_id_hint, link_strength (weak/medium/strong), synergizes_with[], conflicts_with[], notes}
